name: Synology DSM Detection Suite
summary: Sign-ins, brute force, auto block and account protection, Hyper Backup results and integrity, snapshot, replication and backup deletion, log clearing, Task Scheduler, storage and drive health, power, packages and account changes on Synology DSM, from Log Center syslog. Routine logins stay quiet without any configuration; new login pairs, administrators, outside addresses and success after failures alert.
summary_zh: Synology DSM 的登入、暴力破解、自動封鎖與帳號保護、Hyper Backup 結果與完整性檢查、快照／複寫／備份被刪除、記錄被清除、工作排程器、儲存與硬碟健康、電源、套件與帳號變更，來源為記錄中心的 syslog。例行登入不需任何設定就保持安靜；新的登入組合、管理員、外部位址與失敗後成功才告警。
notes: Wazuh 4.14.7 ships no Synology decoder: DSM's sign-in lines reached the manager undecoded and matched nothing, or the generic rule 1002 when they contained the word failure. The pack decodes DSM's Connection, System and Hyper Backup categories and the file transfer logs in the BSD (RFC 3164) format that Log Center sends by default, and also the DSM 6 wording and the IETF (RFC 5424) format. Since 1.2 the wording follows DSM's own message catalogues, read from the DSM 7.2.2-72806 and 7.4.1-90080 firmware.

A successful login is not an alert by itself. Storage and monitoring clients sign in to DSM every few seconds: measured on one NAS, 48,987 sign-ins a day, all one account polling from five Proxmox VE hosts, which as level 3 alerts came to 364,471 a week. With version 1.1 and nothing configured, an ordinary account signing in from a private address is recorded at level 2, and the first login of each (account, address, service) pair on a NAS is level 3: that client gives five alerts, ever. First-seen pairs are kept in the manager's fts queue and survive restarts.

What raises a login: a built-in administrator name (admin, administrator, root, also as DOMAIN\Administrator) from a private address is level 3; any account from an address outside the private ranges (10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16, 127/8, 100.64/10, fc00::/7, fe80::/10) is level 5, an administrator name level 8; a success after at least four failures from the same address or for the same account within ten minutes is level 10, and a success from an address or for an account that set off a brute force rule within 30 minutes is level 12. A shell login over SSH or Telnet, which DSM allows only to administrators, is level 5 the first time for a pair and level 8 from outside; repeats are recorded at level 2, so a scheduled SSH job does not flood. Opening a shared folder and the password step of a two-factor sign-in are recorded below the alert level.

Optional tuning, not needed for the defaults: accounts in etc/lists/jt-synology-service-accounts drop to level 0 when they sign in from a private address (they still alert from outside, and their failures and shell logins still alert); accounts in etc/lists/jt-synology-admin-accounts are treated like the built-in administrator names. Both lists ship with a placeholder.

Failures: a failed sign-in or login, and a login DSM rejected, is level 5; a correct password followed by a failed second factor level 6. Eight failures from one address in two minutes is level 10, split into internal (132024) and external (132025) addresses so that a response can be tied to external ones only; ten failures for one account in five minutes is level 10, which also counts the failures DSM logs without an address. DSM's own auto block of an address is level 10 (132027 internal, 132028 external), from either the Connection or the System category; Account Protection blocking an account is level 8 (132029, which in 1.1 never matched the real wording). A client refused before it names an account ("Host [..] failed to connect") and an SMB client offering only NTLMv1 are level 3 and do not count as password guesses: on the NAS measured, all 835 NTLMv1 refusals in a year came from one network scanner trying the guest account.

Hyper Backup: a successful task and a clean integrity check are level 2 (recorded, no alert; 1.1 wrongly raised "No error was found" to level 10), a failed task level 10, the same task failing three times in three days level 12, a partial backup level 7, a cancelled, skipped or discarded one level 5. A broken backup target, corrupted destination data, an incomplete stored version and a Btrfs checksum mismatch are level 12. A deleted backup task, a deleted destination, and stored data removed on a Hyper Backup Vault are level 8, because deleting backups is what ransomware operators do before encrypting (MITRE T1490); a restore is level 3. The three-day rule depends on the manager's correlation memory (the last 8,192 events of level 1 or more), which on a busy manager covers much less than three days; every single failure still alerts.

System log: account and group changes and password changes are level 6, an account added to administrators level 8; a degraded or crashed volume, storage pool, SSD cache or LUN level 12; a failing drive (S.M.A.R.T., bad sectors, I/O and read errors, end of lifespan) or other failing hardware (fans, power supplies, overheating, memory errors) level 10, and a shutdown forced by overheating or a fan failure level 12; running on UPS battery level 8, low battery or safe shutdown level 10, a UPS that is unplugged, unreachable or abnormal level 5; package installs and removals level 5, a failed DSM update or DSM Security Fix level 7; SSH started level 6, Telnet started level 8; a shared folder created, its access rights set or its recycle bin disabled level 5, a shared folder deleted level 8; certificate changes level 5. An administrator suppressing a drive warning and failed settings imports no longer alert (1.1 raised some of them to level 10).

What ransomware does on a NAS before it encrypts, and what an intruder does to stay: a snapshot deleted by an account, or a refused deletion of an immutable one, is level 8, five on one NAS within ten minutes level 12 (deletions by retention, written "by retention rules" or "by [SYSTEM]", stay at level 0); a deleted replication level 8, a failed snapshot or replication level 7; an emptied recycle bin level 3; auto block switched off and a cleared log level 10; auto block list edited by hand level 5; a scheduled task created level 6, a boot-time triggered task level 8, tasks removed, renamed or failing level 3; DSM finding a malware pattern in rc.local level 12; the RESET button pressed to reset the administrator password level 10; Telnet started level 8 (DSM's telnetd had an unauthenticated remote code execution flaw, CVE-2026-32746, Synology-SA-26:03); a router port opened through UPnP level 6; the clock or time synchronisation changed level 5; the encryption key vault reset or disabled level 8.

File transfer logs are off in DSM by default and write one line per file operation. With them on, deletes and renames alert only in bulk: 300 deletions in a minute by one account is level 10, 100 renames in a minute level 12, the second being how file-encrypting malware looks from the NAS. Reads and writes never alert. Every service (SMB, AFP, FTP, TFTP, WebDAV, File Station) uses the same line format.

What was checked: the sign-in, failed sign-in, two-factor, NTLMv1 and Hyper Backup success lines come from a real DSM 7 NAS. Every other line follows DSM's message catalogues in the 7.2.2-72806 and 7.4.1-90080 firmware, word for word; all 1,810 templates of the 7.4.1 System catalogue were replayed against the rules in a test manager, and each template fires only the rule written for it. No System-category line has been captured from a real NAS yet, so the patterns allow for an optional acting account and a missing final period. Shared folder snapshots deleted by retention are expected to say "by [SYSTEM]"; if a NAS shows retention deletions at level 8, that wording differs.

Deliberately not done: logins carry no built-in authentication_success group, because that attaches built-in correlation rules (40101 for system account names, which include guest, and 40112) next to the allowlist. Version 1.2 removed the Security Advisor, antivirus and two-factor reset rules of 1.1: their wording is in neither firmware's catalogue, so they could never fire. Not decoded: NFS mounts (the catalogue does not show which field holds the address), Active Backup for Business (its strings are not in the firmware), DSM 6 Local Backup failures. DSM does not log its version when it updates, so the pack cannot tell a patched build from a vulnerable one. The NAS runs no agent, so a response can only act elsewhere (see the active response).

PREREQUISITE: the manager must accept syslog from the NAS (a <remote> block with connection syslog and the NAS in allowed-ips), and the Log Center package must be installed on the NAS: DSM's built-in Log Center cannot send logs. Send in BSD format, with at least the Connection and System categories. In a cluster, the node that receives the syslog analyses it: declare the two lists in that node's ossec.conf too, because the cluster copies list files but not ossec.conf.
notes_zh: Wazuh 4.14.7 沒有內建 Synology 解碼器：DSM 的登入記錄送到管理端後沒有解碼、不命中任何規則，含有 failure 字樣時只命中通用的 1002。本套件解碼 DSM 的 Connection、System、Hyper Backup 類別與檔案傳輸記錄，格式為記錄中心預設送出的 BSD（RFC 3164），也接受 DSM 6 的寫法與 IETF（RFC 5424）格式。1.2 版起，比對的文字依據 DSM 自己的訊息目錄，取自 DSM 7.2.2-72806 與 7.4.1-90080 韌體。

成功登入本身不是告警。儲存或監控用戶端每隔幾秒就登入 DSM 一次：在一台 NAS 上實測，每天 48,987 次登入，全是同一個帳號從五台 Proxmox VE 主機輪詢，以 level 3 告警計算一週就是 364,471 筆。1.1 版在什麼都不設定的情況下，一般帳號從私有位址登入記錄為 level 2，每台 NAS 上每一組（帳號、位址、服務）第一次登入為 level 3：那個用戶端從頭到尾只會產生五則告警。第一次出現的組合存在管理端的 fts 佇列裡，重新啟動後仍然保留。

會讓登入升級的情況：內建管理員名稱（admin、administrator、root，也包含 DOMAIN\Administrator）從私有位址登入為 level 3；任何帳號從私有網段（10/8、172.16/12、192.168/16、127/8、100.64/10、fc00::/7、fe80::/10）以外的位址登入為 level 5，管理員名稱為 level 8；十分鐘內同一位址或同一帳號失敗至少四次後登入成功為 level 10，30 分鐘內觸發過暴力破解規則的位址或帳號登入成功為 level 12。經 SSH 或 Telnet 登入 shell（DSM 只允許管理員這麼做）在某組合第一次出現時為 level 5、來自外部時為 level 8；重複的登入記錄為 level 2，排程的 SSH 工作不會洗版。開啟共用資料夾、兩步驟驗證的密碼階段，都記錄在告警等級之下。
選用的調校，預設行為不需要它們：etc/lists/jt-synology-service-accounts 裡的帳號從私有位址登入時降為 level 0（從外部登入仍會告警，失敗與 shell 登入也仍會告警）；etc/lists/jt-synology-admin-accounts 裡的帳號比照內建管理員名稱處理。兩份清單出貨時都只有預留項目。

失敗：登入失敗與 DSM 拒絕的登入為 level 5，密碼正確但第二道驗證失敗為 level 6。同一位址兩分鐘內失敗八次為 level 10，並依內部（132024）與外部（132025）位址分開，讓主動回應可以只綁外部位址；同一帳號五分鐘內失敗十次為 level 10，DSM 沒有記下位址的失敗也算在內。DSM 自己的自動封鎖為 level 10（132027 內部、132028 外部），不論出現在 Connection 或 System 類別；帳號保護封鎖帳號為 level 8（132029，1.1 版從未比中真正的寫法）。尚未報出帳號就被拒絕的用戶端（「Host [..] failed to connect」）以及只提供 NTLMv1 的 SMB 用戶端為 level 3，不算猜密碼：實測的那台 NAS 一年內 835 次 NTLMv1 拒絕，全部來自同一台以 guest 帳號嘗試的網路掃描主機。

Hyper Backup：工作成功與完整性檢查沒有錯誤為 level 2（記錄但不告警；1.1 版把「No error was found」誤判為 level 10），失敗為 level 10，同一工作三天內失敗三次為 level 12，部分完成為 level 7，取消、略過或捨棄為 level 5。備份目標損毀、目的地資料毀損、儲存的版本不完整、Btrfs 檢查碼不符為 level 12。刪除備份工作、刪除備份目的地、在 Hyper Backup Vault 上移除已儲存的資料為 level 8，因為勒索軟體攻擊者在加密前就是先刪備份（MITRE T1490）；還原為 level 3。三天的規則依賴管理端的關聯記憶（最近 8,192 筆 level 1 以上的事件），在繁忙的管理端遠不到三天；每一次失敗本身仍然會告警。

系統記錄：帳號與群組變更、密碼變更為 level 6，帳號被加入 administrators 為 level 8；磁碟區、儲存集區、SSD 快取或 LUN 降級、損毀為 level 12；硬碟故障（S.M.A.R.T.、壞軌、I/O 與讀取錯誤、壽命將盡）或其他硬體故障（風扇、電源供應器、過熱、記憶體錯誤）為 level 10，因過熱或風扇故障而強制關機為 level 12；改由 UPS 電池供電為 level 8，電池電量低或安全關機為 level 10，UPS 被拔除、無法連線或狀態異常為 level 5；套件安裝與移除為 level 5，DSM 更新或 DSM Security Fix 安裝失敗為 level 7；啟動 SSH 為 level 6，啟動 Telnet 為 level 8；建立共用資料夾、設定其存取權限或停用其資源回收筒為 level 5，刪除共用資料夾為 level 8；憑證變更為 level 5。管理員關閉硬碟警告、匯入設定失敗不再告警（1.1 版把其中一些誤判為 level 10）。

勒索軟體在 NAS 上加密前會做的事，以及入侵者為了留下來會做的事：帳號刪除快照，或刪除不可變快照被拒，為 level 8，同一台 NAS 十分鐘內五次為 level 12（保留原則造成的刪除寫的是「by retention rules」或「by [SYSTEM]」，維持 level 0）；刪除複寫為 level 8，快照或複寫失敗為 level 7；清空資源回收筒為 level 3；關閉自動封鎖與清除記錄為 level 10；手動編輯自動封鎖清單為 level 5；建立排程工作為 level 6，建立開機時觸發的工作為 level 8，工作被移除、改名或執行失敗為 level 3；DSM 在 rc.local 發現惡意程式樣式為 level 12；按下 RESET 按鈕重設管理員密碼為 level 10；啟動 Telnet 為 level 8（DSM 的 telnetd 有不需認證的遠端程式碼執行漏洞 CVE-2026-32746，Synology-SA-26:03）；透過 UPnP 在路由器開啟連接埠為 level 6；變更系統時鐘或時間同步為 level 5；重設或停用加密金鑰庫為 level 8。
檔案傳輸記錄在 DSM 預設是關閉的，而且每一個檔案操作就寫一行。開啟後，刪除與重新命名只在大量發生時告警：同一帳號一分鐘內刪除 300 個檔案為 level 10，一分鐘內重新命名 100 個檔案為 level 12，後者正是加密型惡意程式從 NAS 端看起來的樣子。讀取與寫入一律不告警。所有服務（SMB、AFP、FTP、TFTP、WebDAV、File Station）使用同一種記錄格式。

驗證過的：登入、登入失敗、兩步驟驗證、NTLMv1 與 Hyper Backup 成功的記錄來自真實的 DSM 7 NAS。其餘記錄逐字依據 DSM 7.2.2-72806 與 7.4.1-90080 韌體裡的訊息目錄；7.4.1 System 目錄的全部 1,810 個樣板都在測試用管理端重播過，每個樣板只觸發為它而寫的規則。目前還沒從真實的 NAS 收到過 System 類別的記錄，所以比對時允許前面帶執行帳號、也允許結尾沒有句點。保留原則刪除共用資料夾快照時，預期寫的是「by [SYSTEM]」；若某台 NAS 的保留原則刪除出現 level 8，代表寫法不同。

刻意不做的：登入不帶內建的 authentication_success 群組，因為那會把內建的關聯規則（針對系統帳號名稱的 40101，名單包含 guest，以及 40112）掛到允許清單規則的旁邊。1.2 版移除了 1.1 版的資安顧問、防毒與兩步驟驗證重設規則：兩個版本韌體的訊息目錄裡都沒有那些寫法，它們永遠不會觸發。不解碼的：NFS 掛載（目錄看不出哪個欄位是位址）、Active Backup for Business（韌體裡沒有它的字串）、DSM 6 的本機備份失敗。DSM 更新時不記錄版本，所以本套件無法分辨已修補與有漏洞的版本。NAS 上沒有 agent，主動回應只能在別處執行（見主動回應）。

前提條件：管理端必須接受 NAS 送來的 syslog（<remote> 區段設 connection 為 syslog，並把 NAS 加入 allowed-ips），而且 NAS 上必須安裝「記錄中心」套件：DSM 內建的記錄中心無法傳送記錄。以 BSD 格式送出，至少包含 Connection 與 System 類別。叢集環境由接收 syslog 的那個節點負責分析：請在該節點的 ossec.conf 也宣告這兩份清單，因為叢集只同步清單檔、不同步 ossec.conf。
author: Jason Tools

setup.title: Install the pack and reload the ruleset on every node
setup.title_zh: 安裝套件並在所有節點重新載入規則集
setup.body: Install from this page, then use Reload Ruleset on the Rules tab. A cluster synchronises rule files but does not reload the workers.
setup.body_zh: 在本頁安裝後，到「規則」分頁按「重新載入規則集」。叢集只同步規則檔、不會重載 worker。

setup.title: Accept syslog from the NAS on the manager
setup.title_zh: 讓管理端接受 NAS 送來的 syslog
setup.body: Add a <remote> block with connection syslog to ossec.conf on the node the NAS will send to, with the NAS address in allowed-ips (one block per port and protocol: a syslog block with <protocol>tcp,udp</protocol> listens on TCP only, with just a warning in ossec.log; a node that already listens for syslog only needs the address added). Open the port in the manager's host firewall. remoted reads <remote> only when it starts, so restart the manager: agents reconnect within a minute. In a cluster, also declare etc/lists/jt-synology-service-accounts and etc/lists/jt-synology-admin-accounts in that node's <ruleset>, because the cluster copies list files but not ossec.conf.
setup.body_zh: 在 NAS 要送往的那個節點的 ossec.conf 加上 connection 為 syslog 的 <remote> 區段，並把 NAS 位址加入 allowed-ips（每個連接埠與協定一個區段：syslog 區段寫 <protocol>tcp,udp</protocol> 時只會聽 TCP，ossec.log 裡只有一則警告；已經在收 syslog 的節點只要加上位址）。在管理端主機的防火牆開放該連接埠。remoted 只在啟動時讀取 <remote>，所以要重新啟動管理端：agent 會在一分鐘內重新連線。叢集環境還要在該節點的 <ruleset> 宣告 etc/lists/jt-synology-service-accounts 與 etc/lists/jt-synology-admin-accounts，因為叢集只同步清單檔、不同步 ossec.conf。
setup.verify: tcpdump -i any -nn -A 'udp port 514 and host 192.0.2.20' shows lines such as <14>Oct 11 11:12:30 nas1 Connection: User [...] once the NAS sends.
setup.verify_zh: NAS 開始送出後，tcpdump -i any -nn -A 'udp port 514 and host 192.0.2.20' 應看到 <14>Oct 11 11:12:30 nas1 Connection: User [...] 這類記錄。

setup.title: Send the DSM logs to the manager from Log Center
setup.title_zh: 在 DSM 記錄中心把記錄送到管理端
setup.body: Install the Log Center package from Package Center first: DSM's built-in Log Center shows logs but cannot send them. Then open Log Center, Log Sending, and tick Send logs to a syslog server. Server: the manager node's address. Port and transfer protocol: those of the <remote> block (UDP, or TCP if the block says tcp). Log format: BSD (RFC 3164). Log types: at least Connection and System (the System category carries storage, account, snapshot, Task Scheduler and security setting changes), and the file transfer logs only if they are turned on. Leave SSL off: Wazuh's syslog listener does not accept TLS. IETF (RFC 5424) also decodes, but Wazuh 4.x does not parse its header, so those alerts carry no host or program name, and over TCP Wazuh needs one message per line: a sender that frames IETF messages by length instead is never received. Apply, then Send test log. The change takes effect at once and does not interrupt any service on the NAS.
setup.body_zh: 先從「套件中心」安裝「記錄中心」套件：DSM 內建的記錄中心只能檢視記錄，無法傳送。接著開啟「記錄中心」→「記錄傳送」，勾選「傳送記錄到 syslog 伺服器」。伺服器：管理端節點的位址。連接埠與傳輸協定：與 <remote> 區段相同（UDP；區段若設 tcp 則選 TCP）。記錄格式：BSD（RFC 3164）。記錄類型：至少選 Connection 與 System（System 類別包含儲存、帳號、快照、工作排程器與安全性設定的變更），檔案傳輸記錄只在有開啟時才選。不要勾選 SSL：Wazuh 的 syslog 接收端不支援 TLS。IETF（RFC 5424）也能解碼，但 Wazuh 4.x 不解析它的標頭，告警會缺少主機與程式名稱；而且走 TCP 時 Wazuh 要求一行一則訊息，以長度分隔 IETF 訊息的送出端完全收不到。套用後按「傳送測試記錄」。設定立即生效，不會中斷 NAS 上的任何服務。
setup.verify: Sign in to DSM in a browser from a workstation. The first time, expect rule 132033 (level 3, a new account and address pair) on the manager; later sign-ins are recorded as 132010 at level 2. Send test log should raise 132096. To check that the System category arrives, create a scheduled task in Control Panel, Task Scheduler and delete it again: expect 132097 (level 6), then 132099 (level 3).
setup.verify_zh: 從一台工作站用瀏覽器登入 DSM。第一次登入時管理端應出現規則 132033（level 3，新的帳號與位址組合）；之後的登入記錄為 132010（level 2）。「傳送測試記錄」應觸發 132096。要確認 System 類別有送到，請在「控制台」→「工作排程器」建立一個排程工作再刪除：應先出現 132097（level 6），再出現 132099（level 3）。

setup.title: Turn on Auto Block and Account Protection in DSM
setup.title_zh: 在 DSM 啟用自動封鎖與帳號保護
setup.body: Synology's advice after the StealthWorker and eCh0raix brute force campaigns that ended in ransomware. Control Panel, Security, Protection: enable Auto Block (for example 10 attempts within 5 minutes); DSM then blocks the address itself and logs it, which raises 132027 or 132028. Control Panel, Security, Account: enable Account Protection, which blocks an account for untrusted clients after repeated failures and raises 132029. Put the management networks in the Auto Block allow list first, or an administrator who mistypes a password locks himself out of the NAS.
setup.body_zh: 這是 Synology 在 StealthWorker 與 eCh0raix 暴力破解（後續演變成勒索軟體）事件之後的建議。「控制台」→「安全性」→「保護」：啟用「自動封鎖」（例如 5 分鐘內嘗試 10 次）；DSM 會自己封鎖該位址並記錄下來，觸發 132027 或 132028。「控制台」→「安全性」→「帳號」：啟用「帳號保護」，對不受信任的用戶端在多次失敗後封鎖該帳號，觸發 132029。請先把管理網段加入自動封鎖的允許清單，否則打錯密碼的管理員會把自己擋在 NAS 外面。

setup.title: Turn off Telnet on the NAS
setup.body: Synology-SA-26:03 (critical): DSM's telnetd allows unauthenticated remote code execution (CVE-2026-32746), and Telnet sends passwords in clear text. Synology's mitigation is to disable the Telnet service: Control Panel, Terminal (Terminal and SNMP), untick Enable Telnet service, then Apply; use SSH where a shell is needed. Fixed in DSM 7.3.2-86009-3, 7.2.2-72806-8 and 7.2.1-69057-11. Takes effect at once; only open Telnet sessions are cut. Starting Telnet again raises 132089 (level 8).
setup.body_zh: Synology-SA-26:03（重大）：DSM 的 telnetd 有不需認證的遠端程式碼執行漏洞（CVE-2026-32746），而且 Telnet 以明文傳送密碼。Synology 的緩解方式是停用 Telnet 服務：「控制台」→「終端機」（終端機與 SNMP），取消勾選「啟動 Telnet 服務」後套用；需要 shell 時改用 SSH。已在 DSM 7.3.2-86009-3、7.2.2-72806-8 與 7.2.1-69057-11 修正。立即生效，只會中斷已開啟的 Telnet 連線。之後若再啟動 Telnet，會觸發 132089（level 8）。
setup.verify: The System log shows "Telnet service was stopped."; no 132089 afterwards.
setup.verify_zh: 系統記錄出現「Telnet service was stopped.」；之後不再出現 132089。

setup.title: Make snapshots immutable
setup.body: Synology's ransomware guidance: Snapshot Replication, Snapshots, select the shared folder, Settings, enable Immutable snapshots and set the protection period (Btrfs volume, DSM 7.2 or later). An immutable snapshot cannot be deleted by any account, including an administrator whose password was stolen, until the period ends. A deletion attempt is then logged as "Failed to delete a shared folder snapshot ..." and raises 132054 (level 8), five within ten minutes 132055 (level 12). Immutable snapshots use space until they expire: size the protection period to the free space.
setup.body_zh: Synology 的勒索軟體防護建議：「Snapshot Replication」→「快照」→ 選擇共用資料夾 →「設定」，啟用「不可變更的快照」並設定保護期間（需 Btrfs 磁碟區、DSM 7.2 以上）。保護期間內任何帳號都無法刪除該快照，包括密碼被盜的管理員。之後的刪除嘗試會記錄為「Failed to delete a shared folder snapshot ...」，觸發 132054（level 8），十分鐘內五次觸發 132055（level 12）。不可變更的快照在到期前會持續佔用空間：保護期間請依可用空間設定。

setup.title: Turn on the file transfer logs for deletes and renames
setup.title_zh: 開啟檔案傳輸記錄（刪除與重新命名）
setup.body: Control Panel, File Services, SMB: tick Enable transfer logs, then in Log Settings choose delete, rename and move (the same for AFP, FTP or WebDAV if they are used). Leave read and write off: every file operation is one syslog message, and on a busy share reads and writes are thousands a minute. Only bulk deletes and renames alert (132052, 132053).
setup.body_zh: 「控制台」→「檔案服務」→「SMB」：勾選「啟用傳輸記錄」，在「記錄設定」選擇刪除、重新命名與移動（有使用 AFP、FTP、WebDAV 的話也一樣）。讀取與寫入請保持關閉：每一個檔案操作就是一則 syslog，繁忙的共用資料夾每分鐘的讀寫會有數千筆。只有大量刪除與重新命名會告警（132052、132053）。

setup.title: List the accounts that sign in for monitoring or storage
setup.title_zh: 列出用於監控或儲存而頻繁登入的帳號
setup.body: Optional: the defaults already keep a polling account quiet (one first-seen alert per address). One line per account, the name exactly as DSM writes it between the brackets, then reload the ruleset. Their logins from private addresses drop to level 0; logins from outside, failures and SSH logins still alert.
setup.body_zh: 選用：預設行為已經讓輪詢帳號保持安靜（每個位址只有一則第一次出現的告警）。每個帳號一行，名稱與 DSM 記錄中方括號裡的寫法完全相同，加入後重新載入規則集。這些帳號從私有位址的登入降為 level 0；從外部的登入、失敗與 SSH 登入仍會告警。

setup.title: List the administrator accounts
setup.body: Optional: listed accounts are treated like the built-in administrator names (admin, administrator, root): level 3 from a private address, level 8 from outside, instead of level 2 and 5. Add the accounts in the administrators group, then reload the ruleset.
setup.body_zh: 選用：名單上的帳號比照內建管理員名稱（admin、administrator、root）處理：從私有位址為 level 3、從外部為 level 8，而不是 level 2 與 5。請加入 administrators 群組中的帳號，再重新載入規則集。

active_response.title: Block an external address that attacks the NAS, at the edge firewall
active_response.title_zh: 在邊界防火牆封鎖攻擊 NAS 的外部位址
active_response.body: The NAS runs no agent, so Wazuh cannot block anything on it; DSM's own Auto Block already blocks the address there. This response blocks the address one step further out, on the edge firewall, for an hour, after a brute force from an external address (132025) or a DSM auto block of one (132028), so that it cannot move on to other services. Set the location to the agent on the edge firewall: firewall-drop works on a Linux firewall (iptables or nftables); on OPNsense use the os-wazuh-agent plugin's opnsense-fw command instead. Never use location local: these events are made by the manager from syslog, so local blocks on the manager. Internal addresses (132024, 132027) have no response: the edge firewall does not stand between them and the NAS. Risk: a public address shared by many people (an office or partner NAT, a mobile carrier's CGNAT) is cut off from the whole site, not only the NAS, for an hour after one of them mistypes a password eight times. If DSM is published behind a reverse proxy or relay, DSM may log the proxy's address and the response would block the proxy. Syslog carries no authentication: anyone who can send a UDP packet with the NAS's source address can invent a line and get any address blocked, so narrow allowed-ips to the NAS and prefer TCP before enabling this. Put your own public and VPN egress addresses in the manager's white_list first.
active_response.body_zh: NAS 上沒有 agent，Wazuh 無法在 NAS 上封鎖任何東西；DSM 自己的自動封鎖已經在 NAS 上擋下該位址。這個回應在更外層的邊界防火牆封鎖該位址一小時，觸發條件是外部位址的暴力破解（132025）或 DSM 自動封鎖了外部位址（132028），讓它無法轉往其他服務。location 請設為邊界防火牆上的 agent：Linux 防火牆用 firewall-drop（iptables 或 nftables）；OPNsense 請改用 os-wazuh-agent 外掛提供的 opnsense-fw 指令。絕對不要用 local：這些事件是管理端從 syslog 產生的，local 會封鎖在管理端本身。內部位址（132024、132027）不掛回應：邊界防火牆並不在它們與 NAS 之間。風險：多人共用的公開位址（辦公室或合作夥伴的 NAT、行動業者的 CGNAT）只要其中一人連續打錯八次密碼，整個站台（不只 NAS）就會對它們斷線一小時。若 DSM 是透過反向代理或中繼對外，DSM 記到的可能是代理的位址，回應會把代理擋掉。syslog 沒有任何認證：任何能以 NAS 來源位址送出 UDP 封包的人，都能偽造一行記錄讓任意位址被封鎖，所以啟用前請把 allowed-ips 縮小到 NAS 本身，並優先使用 TCP。請先把自己的公開位址與 VPN 出口位址加入管理端的 white_list。
